sources.title: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, Applying computer algebra systems with SAT solvers to the Williamson conjecture, J. Symbolic Comput. 100 (2020), Section 2.2 and Table 1
Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, Enumeration of Williamson sequences divisible by 2 or 3, Zenodo (2018), file williamson-32.txt, sha256 2fe54b3639107fc7bd7d04bb68ccb3de8acf930b27ca48cd9af82e14c45a9f35

notes: 2304 quadruples, no two equivalent: every class under the board's equivalence inside the 152 published classes of the cited enumeration. They were obtained from the one quadruple per class in the authors' dataset by applying the two operations the published equivalence has and the board's does not, the cyclic shift of a single block by n/2 and the negation of every second entry of all four blocks, and are stored in canonical form. The list is complete exactly when the published classification is. No search was rerun for this entry, so the count is a lower bound here.
